name: tessaridb
description: Work with TessariDB: write TessariQL, design stores across its engines, connect the clients, run a node or a cluster, run TessariDB S3 alone or as an erasure-coded cluster, run TessariDB OAuth on one server or across regions, and embed the TessariKV engine, without the mistakes that succeed quietly.
